snippet.title: The Detectorist Guild | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore a cosy British village in 1999 and uncover lost treasures, hidden artefacts and secrets buried beneath the countryside in The Detectorist Guild.

Welcome to Shiverly.

Step into the muddy boots of James, a young detectorist exploring a quintessential British village filled with lost keepsakes, local history and mysteries waiting to be uncovered.

Help villagers recover missing belongings, donate rare finds to the museum, upgrade your equipment and piece together a mystery that slowly pulls James and his family deeper into the village’s past.

Featuring:
🔎 Fully simulated metal detecting gameplay
🌿 Relaxing exploration and collecting
🏡 A cosy British countryside setting
🏛 Museum donations and artefact discovery
🕵️ A slow-burn mystery beneath the surface
🎮 Retro-modern 2.5D visuals blending pixels and voxels

Play the Demo Now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3248990/The_Detectorist_Guild/
